from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single provided paper regarding its citation relationships."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the paper being analyzed")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that this paper explicitly cites in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregation of all papers found in the collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
